$schema_note: Source of truth for the architecture explorer (docs/explorer/), Mermaid diagrams, and component relationship tables. Statuses: implemented | partial | planned. Layers: 1=people, 2=agents, 3=choke_points, 4=control_plane, 5=infrastructure, 6=outputs. Validated by scripts/validate-docs.mjs.

flows.known_agent: Known agent action: SDK -> gateway -> policy -> (approval) -> execute -> receipt -> SOC
flows.anonymous_agent: Anonymous agent: run created -> signed command -> sensor -> cage -> egress/broker -> runtime events -> contain
flows.approval: Approval lifecycle: require_approval -> human decision on frozen hash -> single-use consume
flows.receipt: Receipt chain: canonical body -> hash -> prev-hash link -> verify -> evidence pack
flows.soc_incident: SOC: decision/runtime events -> detect -> correlate -> alert -> incident -> respond
flows.ban_quarantine: Containment: detection or analyst -> freeze/quarantine/revoke/ban -> auth fails closed
flows.egress_block: Egress: sandbox traffic -> egress proxy allowlist -> block + runtime event (planned)
flows.prompt_lineage: Prompt-to-action lineage: ingest/prompt capture -> trust label -> action hash -> receipt (partial)

nodes.label: Developer
nodes.description: Integrates the SDK, registers agents/tools, writes Cedar policy.

nodes.label: SOC Analyst
nodes.description: Investigates alerts/incidents in the console; freezes, quarantines, revokes agents.

nodes.label: Human Approver
nodes.description: Approves or rejects the exact frozen action (hash-bound), via console or Slack.

nodes.label: Admin / Tenant Operator
nodes.description: Manages tenants, tokens, API keys, policies, deployments.

nodes.label: Known Agent (SDK)
nodes.description: Cooperative agent whose tool calls are wrapped by @protect_tool / protect().

nodes.label: MCP Agent
nodes.description: Agent calling tools on registered MCP servers; gated by manifest pinning + drift detection.

nodes.label: Anonymous / Unknown Agent
nodes.description: Untrusted workload. Run registry + runtime-event ingest exist; sandbox execution is designed (cage runner), not implemented.

nodes.label: CI / Browser Agent
nodes.description: CI-runner and browser-automation agents; target consumers of the node sensor + cage.

nodes.label: Aegis SDK
nodes.description: Fail-closed client: canonicalizes the action (aegis-jcs-1), computes action_hash, authorizes, polls approvals, refuses to execute on mismatch/expiry/unreachable-gateway.

nodes.label: Aegis Gateway
nodes.description: Central authorization + control-plane API (Axum REST :8080, gRPC :6334). Every known-agent action passes through POST /v1/authorize.

nodes.label: MCP Gateway (Lite)
nodes.description: MCP server/tool registry inside the gateway: discovery, manifest hash pinning, drift classification, unknown-tool deny.

nodes.label: Tool Broker
nodes.description: Credential-isolating executor: sandboxed agents call the broker, never hold raw secrets (Phase 6).

nodes.label: Egress Proxy
nodes.description: Forced network path for caged workloads: allowlists, block + evidence on violation (Phase 5).

nodes.label: Agent Cage Runner
nodes.description: Disposable sandbox launcher for unknown agents: isolated workspace, no host FS/Docker socket/raw credentials (Phase 4).

nodes.label: Node Sensor
nodes.description: Host/K8s/CI-local sensor: runtime telemetry, durable event queue, signed-command enforcement (Phase 3).

nodes.label: Auth / Tenant Engine
nodes.description: Bearer/JWT (rotatable secrets), optional mTLS agent identity, tenant existence check (bloom-filtered), per-tenant rate limits and quotas.

nodes.label: Policy Engine (Cedar)
nodes.description: Deterministic allow/deny/require_approval; trust-provenance gating (6 levels, tighten-only); risk scoring; hot reload; signed bundles.

nodes.label: Approval Engine
nodes.description: Approvals bound to SHA-256 of the frozen action; edit re-hashes + re-evaluates; single-use atomic consume; TTL expiry; brute-force tracker.

nodes.label: Receipt Engine
nodes.description: Per-tenant hash-chained action receipts (aegis-jcs-1), optional Ed25519 signing, verify single/range/chain endpoints.

nodes.label: SOC Engine
nodes.description: Async pipeline: ingest -> detect (rules/DSL/baselines) -> correlate (alerts->incidents) -> respond (playbooks) -> notify/export. Never in the inline authorize path.

nodes.label: Ban / Quarantine Engine
nodes.description: Freeze/unfreeze/revoke/restore + quarantine implemented via agent status; first-class agent_bans and quarantine_records stores exist; sensor-enforced bans await the control-command dispatch path.

nodes.label: Control Command Protocol
nodes.description: Signed, tenant-bound, replay-protected commands (start/pause/kill/quarantine/ban) to sensors. Store exists; signing/dispatch/ACK routes are designed, not implemented.

nodes.label: Evidence Graph
nodes.description: Links decisions, approvals, receipts, alerts, incidents per run/agent for investigation.

nodes.label: SQLite / PostgreSQL
nodes.description: StorageBackend trait over SQLite (WAL, optional SQLCipher) or Postgres; 30 migrations; tenant-scoped parameterized queries only.

nodes.label: Qdrant (semantic index)
nodes.description: Optional vector index for semantic audit search.

nodes.label: Event Sink (in-process)
nodes.description: Async channel decoupling the authorize hot path from the SOC pipeline; drained on graceful shutdown.

nodes.label: OpenTelemetry / Metrics
nodes.description: Prometheus /metrics; OTLP traces + metrics gated on AEGIS_OTLP_ENDPOINT; tokio runtime metrics; Grafana dashboards.

nodes.label: CI/CD + Supply Chain
nodes.description: fmt/clippy/tests/coverage/fuzz/mutation/SAST/secret+container scans; cosign-signed releases with SLSA provenance and SBOMs.

nodes.label: Kubernetes / Helm / Compose
nodes.description: Helm chart (probes, policy hot-reload), Docker Compose local stacks.

nodes.label: Receipts
nodes.description: Tamper-evident, independently verifiable proof of every protected action.

nodes.label: Alerts & Incidents
nodes.description: Detection hits correlated into incidents with narratives and timelines.

nodes.label: Evidence Packs
nodes.description: Compliance export (GET /v1/compliance/evidence-pack) for SOC 2 / EU AI Act Art. 14.

nodes.label: Audit Logs
nodes.description: Decision-linked audit events; policy transparency log is itself hash-chained.

nodes.label: SOC Console Dashboards
nodes.description: React/Vite console served at /dashboard: overview, fleet, integrity, approvals.
